<reason>PRO won on the central tradeoff: certain, irreversible existence of a transmissible virus in freezers/databases/emails versus speculative defensive payoff. CON conceded no deployed vaccine required creating a novel pandemic-capable virus and retreated to portfolio/surveillance value, which PRO weighed as tweaks not worth a pandemic. PRO also neutralized unverifiability with a workable human-signal enforcement model and operational definition, while CON's visibility/chokepoint story was partly turned as camouflage plus recipes.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B's pressure Q2 demanding a deployed vaccine requiring prior creation, and follow-through in Rebuttal 2/Closing exploiting A's admission that none exists, which collapsed CON's live-virus necessity claim to retrospective risk assessments.</best_rebuttal>
